finding_and_fix: Pinned k6 per-vu-iterations output omits dropped_iterations. The summary hook now supplies dropped_iterations=0 only for fixed-count runs, where scheduled arrivals cannot be dropped; rate-based runs retain the real k6 metric and the summarizer still fails closed if it is missing.

does not prove cleanup against PostgreSQL or production-like app
